title: CameraDistance 2.4: keep both in frame
intro: Reset Scripts first (CameraDistance 2.4.0). The main pawn next to the Arisen; co-op starts by itself; mouse and keyboard hands off. Note any moment where either one leaves the screen.

steps.text: Controller: run the main pawn RIGHT across the screen to ~15 m. Press End
Run him LEFT, past the Arisen, to ~15 m on the other side. Press End
Run him far AHEAD, away from the camera, to ~25 m. Press End
Run him back and BEHIND the camera, ~15 m. Press End
Bring him back next to the Arisen. Press End

probes.coop: local ok, d = pcall(json.load_file, 'DPC_coop.json'); return ok and d and d.active
probes.pscr: local p=H.pawn(0):call('get_Transform'):call('get_Position'); local s=draw.world_to_screen(Vector3f.new(p.x,p.y+1.0,p.z)); return s and string.format('%.0f,%.0f',s.x,s.y) or 'off'
probes.ascr: local p=H.arisen():call('get_Transform'):call('get_Position'); local s=draw.world_to_screen(Vector3f.new(p.x,p.y+1.0,p.z)); return s and string.format('%.0f,%.0f',s.x,s.y) or 'off'
